response.justification: Technically a strong, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years of hands-on experience, deep open-source involvement (own OSS GIS platform, D-lang libraries, conference talks), Linux/DevOps exposure and a completed CS degree — all of which map well to the technical side of the role. However, two requirements are decisive misses: German is listed as 'Basic' against a hard C1 minimum for a client-facing consulting lead in a digital-sovereignty context, and the career track is purely individual-contributor/craftsmanship with no evidence of leading or mentoring a team, owning project delivery, or acting as client-facing architect. There is also no mention of UML/modeling, requirements management, IT security/compliance, or Python. Founding GISCollective and running workshops show initiative and teaching ability, but not the operational leadership depth this executive-level position demands.
strengths: 15+ years broad, hands-on engineering across web, embedded, and high-throughput backends
Genuine open-source credibility: OSS platform founder, published libraries, FOSS4G talk, Linux/Docker/K8s
Proven knowledge-sharing and mentoring instincts via workshops, courses, and dojos
concerns: German only 'Basic' versus the required C1 minimum
No formal team lead, hiring, or project-management responsibility in any role
Missing stated architecture/UML, requirements management, IT security/compliance, and Python experience
